selection_history: Failed3f03013 cold1000 (899 identities) rejected;338c156 all-web-before-roles ablation and a0f25df source exposed role starvation/shared-profile scope risk. Final generic guard4d209fe withholds shared staff/directory pages. Original blind100 is now honestly labelled regression validation; fresh independently selected20 was sealed until final guard freeze. No further research tuning after final guard.
limitations: Private scoring harness/numerical caps unavailable; starter acceptance is structural only
Sample financial semantic corroboration does not verify every source account or period
Strict static-site ownership, no paid search/browser/social source, and limited jobs/news recall
No confidence/precision/recall rate or official qualification inferred
Raw website pages/roles birth dates/PDF notes excluded from public package; official-data exports are rights-filtered subsets
